name: Ferry Landing
description: A waterside landing with a walkable entrance. Connect two landings to run passenger boats.
usage: Use two reachable landings, navigable water between their berths, and walkable access for passengers.
growth: A landing marker gains shelter and a railed boarding walk. Two docking fingers open beside the pier before a ticket hall and harbor beacon welcome the busiest sailings.

name: Taxi Rank
description: A compact curbside pickup point for routes from a taxi depot.

growth: A signed curb gains a canopy, a waiting area, a fare reader, and staffed dispatch. The final night rank adds a rooftop landmark while keeping the boarding strip open.

name: House

growth: Adds floors, a garage, a pool terrace and a glass conservatory wing.

usage: Rotate the building entrance toward a local street and connect that street to the rest of the town.
growth: Kerbed asphalt street that gains lamps, street trees, hydrants, bus stops, signals and flower planters.
